panels.description: Formal Charter House review chamber, continuous with Page 45: pearl-white institutional architecture, a long elevated review bench, restrained jade-teal, amber-orange and steel-violet accents, and a central table holding the compact purifier. Alex, Ada and Bi11bot stand at the near side of the table while generic House representatives sit elevated beyond it. Keep the upper quarter and upper-left quadrant uncluttered for the review chair's long balloon; do not place consequential faces, the purifier or the three figures in that lettering area.

Alex refuses a glowing signature pad on the review table, his open hand stopping just short of it. Lina stands beside the compact purifier. Show the other contributors only as cropped work-worn hands and partial sleeves at the frame edges, with no recognizable lineup; Alex and Lina are the only readable figures. Leave the upper-left and upper-right open for two separate Alex balloons, with a clear gap between them and both tails pointing to Alex. Keep the signature pad, Lina, Alex's refusal hand and the purifier unobstructed.

Director Cassian Lock stands on the left side of the compact purifier and Alex stands on the right, facing one another across the table in the same review chamber. Lock is a composed adult man in his late fifties to early sixties, tall and lean, with a narrow face, pale olive skin, close-cropped silver-templed hair and calm grey eyes; he wears a charcoal and platinum suit with precise seams, polished dark shoes and no visible House crest. Alex remains tense but steady. Keep four separate lettering zones in a clear zigzag: upper-left for Lock's first balloon, upper-right for Alex's reply, lower-left for Lock's second balloon, and lower-right for Alex's final balloon. Keep all four zones separated from one another and keep the purifier and both figures unobstructed below.

Large table-level close view of the worn palm-sized bronze Maker's Seal with its open-hand symbol, held in Lina's hand beside the compact purifier. Five distinct contributor hands press deliberately beside it, differentiated by grease, chemical staining, diagnostic hardware, reinforced fabric and fabrication scars; do not show a crowded lineup of faces. A translucent shared provenance record stabilizes above the table in a clean, readable list ordered Lina Vey, Suri Anik, Jalen Orr, Ren Okafor, Alex Phantum. Keep the upper-left quadrant clear for Bi11bot's brief balloon and the lower-right quadrant clear for the closing caption. Keep the Seal and provenance record visually dominant; do not let lettering cover either. The Seal remains with Lina and does not transfer ownership.

items.speaker: REVIEW CHAIR
items.text: The estate of Adrian Phantum. Director Lock advises a signed administrative transfer is ready. Mr. Phantum, do you accept?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: No. It was never mine alone.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Lina Vey, Suri Anik, Jalen Orr and Ren Okafor built it. I built the part none of us had built yet.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: You're refusing a guaranteed purchase for companies that don't exist?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Not the value. The way we create it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: The people who built them. Together. We license them and share the royalties.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Well. It recognized the people who built it.
The record held: five names, spoken aloud.
